data.text: Timing 2026-10-12 on this repository's journal (~1,500 events): hook prompt median 209 ms, p90 239 ms — 0.8.2 measured the same (212 ms), so not a regression of KAD-88, but past the 200 ms budget; KAD-61 measured ~165 ms. rejectedMatches builds a second index for the query terms; sharing it with search is the saving KAD-61 named. Fast-path commands on a small journal stay at ~75 ms, same as 0.8.2.
